adversarial_prisms.name: Sovereignty & polling elimination
adversarial_prisms.finding: Original design used 60-second cron polling of getSignaturesForAddress — violates CYNIC sovereign principle of zero polling.
adversarial_prisms.resolution: Implemented SolanaSettlementPort trait + WebhookSolanaSettlementAdapter. Settlement detection is now push-based via webhook listener. Zero cron polling anywhere in the stack. Demo binary updated to reflect webhook approach.

adversarial_prisms.name: Production-grade error handling
adversarial_prisms.finding: RPC error handling, retries, and state tracking were incomplete. risk_score was computed by SolanaSafetyDog but NOT propagated through the combined result when SOP sanitizer ran.
adversarial_prisms.resolution: Fixed risk_score propagation in SovereignAgenticToolCallAdapter::process_call — combined_risk_score = sanitization_res.risk_score.max(solana_risk_score). Invalid base58 recipient now correctly yields risk_score 0.80 (Rejected), not 0.0.

adversarial_prisms.name: MCP surface exposure
adversarial_prisms.finding: MCP router solana.rs referenced agentic_tool_call and solana_ops modules that were created on disk but NOT declared in cynic-protocol/src/lib.rs. Workspace Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock missing cynic-zeroclaw-solana member entry.
adversarial_prisms.resolution: Added pub mod agentic_tool_call; pub mod solana_ops; to cynic-protocol/src/lib.rs. Added cynic-zeroclaw-solana to workspace Cargo.toml members. Added package entry to Cargo.lock. Fixed cynic-mcp build.rs to export CYNIC_SOURCE_COMMIT and CYNIC_SOURCE_COMMIT vars.

adversarial_prisms.name: Hermes-Agent MCP integration
adversarial_prisms.finding: Webhook-based settlement notification must be consumable by Hermes-Agent MCP surface as a streaming event.
adversarial_prisms.resolution: SettlementNotification type defined in solana_ports.rs with serde Serialize/Deserialize. WebhookSolanaSettlementAdapter emits structured JSON event suitable for MCP streaming transport. ZeroClaw plugin can emit this as a completion event for downstream MCP consumers.

adversarial_prisms.name: Runtime proof & content addressing
adversarial_prisms.finding: Proof digests generated as SHA-256 of canonical JSON — verified via cynic-protocol digest_json. Adversarial test inputs (invalid recipient, prompt injection) produce distinct digests.
adversarial_prisms.resolution: All test paths assert on proof_digest non-emptiness and SHA-256 length. Demo binary prints proof digest for traceability.

adversarial_prisms.name: Long-running task persistence
adversarial_prisms.finding: No durable persistence for long-running settlement monitoring tasks.
adversarial_prisms.resolution: Webhook-based architecture eliminates the need for long-running polling tasks — the runtime subscribes to push events and wakes on arrival. No daemon needed. WebhookSolanaSettlementAdapter registers a listener that persists until explicit cancellation.
adversarial_prisms.residual_risk: Webhook receiver itself must be durable across process restarts. Out of scope for T1 bounty — requires cynic-host runtime takeover integration.

toolchain_notes.ice_workaround: RUST_MIN_STACK=4294967296 (4GB) + RUSTFLAGS='--cap-lints=allow -C codegen-units=4' required to avoid rustc SIGSEGV ICE on idna_adapter::MIDDLE_LTR_MASK const evaluation in full codegen (test profile). Pre-existing toolchain bug, not code defect.
